followUps.title: Fix dotnet format failures in CatalogApi.cs that predate this change (whitespace at lines 91/98, missing UTF-8 BOM)
followUps.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes fails on CatalogApi.cs whenever it is changed, so any story touching it reports a format failure it did not cause.

followUps.title: Switch the catalog page's grid and container to the shared .page-content/.card-grid classes in app.css
followUps.reason: Catalog.razor.css and CatalogListItem.razor.css are outside this subtask's owns, so the catalog still declares its own grid and container rules that match the new shared classes in app.css.
